playOnSelect.label: Play on select
playOnSelect.hint: Moving the selection with ↑ ↓ starts preview immediately.

loopPreview.label: Loop preview
loopPreview.hint: Sticky. Stays on until you turn it off.

waveformView.label: Waveform view
waveformView.hint: Stereo files can show both channels or one summed lane.

coloredWaveforms.label: Waveform color
coloredWaveforms.hint: Bass, mids, and treble tint the wave. Theme sets the hues; overlapping bands mix.

outputDevice.label: Output device
outputDevice.hint: Preview only. Sift never claims your DAW's device exclusively.

newFiles.label: New files inside a root
newFiles.hint: Roots are watched continuously. Renames and moves update in place.

ignoreList.label: Ignore list
ignoreList.hint: Paths and patterns Sift never indexes.

onlineOnly.label: Online only is not Missing
onlineOnly.hint: Dropbox Online only stubs stay in the library with an Online only badge. They are not Missing. Preview, waveforms, and analysis wait until the file is on disk. Restart does not resume analysis. Use Reindex or Analyze.

missingSamples.label: Missing samples
missingSamples.hint_one: {{count}} indexed file is not on disk right now.
missingSamples.hint_other: {{count}} indexed files are not on disk right now.

bpmRange.label: BPM range preset
bpmRange.hint: Narrower ranges guess octaves less often. The Custom analysis dialog starts from this.

splice.label: Use Splice metadata
splice.hint: When Splice Desktop's local catalog is on this machine, prefer its BPM, key, and loop/one-shot over filename and audio guesses.

status.missing: Splice catalog not found. Install or open Splice Desktop once, then try again.

refreshMetadata.label: Refresh metadata
refreshMetadata.hint: Re-match the library to Splice without re-decoding. Fills empty BPM, key, and type when a higher-priority value is not already set.

reanalyze.label: Re-analyze entire library
reanalyze.hint: Erases BPM, key, type, auto tags, and waveforms, then analyzes everything again. Favorites and your tags stay.

dialog.title: Erase analysis data?
dialog.body: This clears BPM, key, type, auto tags, and peakfiles for every sample, including values you edited by hand. Favorites, your tags, and folder roots stay. Analysis then runs again in the background.

custom.title: Custom analysis
custom.body_one: Force-runs on the <0>{{count}} selected sample</0>. Existing values are kept unless you tick the matching box.
custom.body_other: Force-runs on the <0>{{count}} selected samples</0>. Existing values are kept unless you tick the matching box.

overwriteTags.label: Overwrite tags
overwriteTags.hint: replaces tags Sift detected; yours stay

holdHover.label: Hold to hover-preview
holdHover.hint: Hold this key and sweep the list to audition rows under the pointer.

shortcuts.fixedKeysNote: Fixed keys, not rebindable in v1.

key.range: Range select · free time on waveform
key.toggle: Toggle a row in the selection

updates.skippedDev: Updates are off in development builds.

dialog.title: Update available
dialog.body: Sift {{version}} is ready. The app restarts after install.
